title: Levels 37 (the Poolrooms) and 94 (Motion)
note: Shots carry a 37- or 94- prefix: review/b13/sbs holds copies of review/baseline/37 and /94 (reshot in B13 on a build of unchanged main; the B0 sets are kept as 37-b0 and 94-b0) and of review/b13/final/37 and /94. B13 added close spots for the mosaic, a slit, a handrail and a POOL door on Level 37, and on Level 94 for the turf, a road, a town house, the castle wall, a water tower, the fountain, a milk van, the icebox and the radio.
